s01.text: መስከረም ሁለት ሺህ አሥራ ሁለት። እኩለ ቀን ላይ ከአንኮበር ተነሳሁ። አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ። አንድ ጓደኛዬ ሸኘኝ።
s01.subtitle: Meskerem 2012 (late 2019). At midday I left Ankober. Just one backpack. A friend saw me off.

subtitle_check.literal: Meskerem two thousand twelve. At midday I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine saw me off.

s02.text: እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን ድረስ ፒስታ መንገድ። ከዚያ በኋላ አስፋልት።
s02.subtitle: A gravel road as far as Debre Birhan. After that, asphalt.

subtitle_check.literal: Up to Debre Birhan, a gravel road. After that, asphalt.

s03.text: በመስኮት በኩል ተቀመጥኩ። ውጪው ደንና ተራራ ብቻ። እይታው አስደነቀኝ።
s03.subtitle: I sat by the window. Outside, only forest and mountain. The view amazed me.

subtitle_check.literal: I sat by the window. Outside was only forest and mountain. The view amazed me.

s04.text: ላምበረት የደረስኩት ከመሸ በኋላ ነው። ጓደኛዬ እዚያው ጠበቀኝ። ሰው፣ መብራት፣ መኪና፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ጊዜ።
s04.subtitle: I reached Lamberet after dark. My friend was there, waiting for me. People, lights, cars, everything at once.

subtitle_check.literal: It was after dark that I reached Lamberet. My friend waited for me right there. People, lights, cars; all at once.

s06.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደላሎች ከበቡን። «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» «አልጋ?» ከየአቅጣጫው። ግራ ገባን። በመጨረሻ አንዱን መረጥን።
s06.subtitle: At Autobus Tera the brokers closed in on us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every side. We were lost. In the end we picked one.

subtitle_check.literal: When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every direction. We were confused. In the end we chose one.

s07.text: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ። በጣም ጥሩ አይደለም፤ መጥፎም አይደለም። ግን ንጹሕ።
s07.subtitle: One bed in the room. Not very good, not bad. But clean.

subtitle_check.literal: The room has one bed. It is not very good; it is not bad either. But clean.

s08.text: ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
s08.subtitle: In the morning we stood in a long queue and got the ticket.

subtitle_check.literal: In the morning we stood in a long line and bought a ticket.

s09.text: ዛሬ ያንን የመጀመሪያ ሌሊት ሳስታውስ፣ ከቤቱ ለሚወጣ ሁሉ አንድ ነገር እላለሁ፦ የመጀመሪያው ሌሊት ሁሌም ግራ ያጋባል። አትሽሽ። አጣጥመው።
s09.subtitle: Today, remembering that first night, I tell all who leave home one thing: the first night is always confusing. Do not run from it. Savour it.

subtitle_check.literal: Today, when I remember that first night, I say one thing to everyone who leaves home: the first night is always confusing. Don't run away. Savour it.
